verdict.rationale: Vercel's Privacy Notice documents a first-party control: Team Preferences let customers opt out of model training, as described in Section 3 of the Terms of Service. This directly delivers the story's core ability to stop one's data being used for AI training. Missing for 10: details of which data the opt-out covers (e.g., whether it extends to AI Gateway or Vercel Agent traffic), the Section 3 terms text itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the setting works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: Your Team Preferences allow you to: Opt-out of Model Training as described in Section 3 of the Terms of Service.
Customers can learn about how to control the use of their information for AI product training here.
